title: Beetle Among Ghost Tulips
description: A large white beetle with horns and multiple legs sits centrally atop a solid black mound, surrounded by a radiating fan of stylized blue-gray tulips with glowing yellow halos. Below the mound and among the stems are faint white ghost-like figures with simple faces, set against a light blue background with scattered black specks and white particles.
prompt: A surreal scene featuring a large white beetle with prominent horns and multiple legs positioned at the center atop a solid black mound. The beetle is encircled by a wide fan of stylized blue-gray tulips with glowing yellow halos. Beneath the mound and among the green stems are numerous faint white ghost figures with simple facial features. Light blue background with floating black specks and luminous white particles, ink line art with delicate watercolor tones.
